daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿وَإِنْ يَرَوْا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, in is conditional, and an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿آيَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿يُعْرِضُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis. ﴿وَيَقُولُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يعرضوا. ﴿سِحْرٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُسْتَمِرٌّ﴾ an adjective of سحر; the nominal clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَاتَّبَعُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كذبوا. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and a mubtadaʾ (subject); أمر is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) and مستقر is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of oath and genitive, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿مِنَ الْأَنْباءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿ما﴾ fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ an advanced khabar (predicate). ﴿مُزْدَجَرٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of mā.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿حِكْمَةٌ﴾ a badal (substitute) from mā, and بالغة is an adjective of حكمة. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and mā is negating. ﴿تُغْنِ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿النُّذُرُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:6-6.t: ﴿فَتَوَلَّ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (fāʾ of elucidation), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not govern the jussive and has no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿إِلى شَيْءٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿نُكُرٍ﴾ an adjective of شيء.

daas-irab:7-7.t: ﴿خُشَّعاً أَبْصارُهُمْ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), and أبصارهم is the fāʿil (agent) of خشعا. ﴿يَخْرُجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿مِنَ الْأَجْداثِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ﴾ كأن and its noun. ﴿جَرادٌ مُنْتَشِرٌ﴾ its khabar (predicate), and منتشر is an adjective of جراد; the nominal clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿مُهْطِعِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَى الدَّاعِ﴾ the two (preposition and genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them. ﴿يَقُولُ الْكافِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿هذا يَوْمٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿عَسِرٌ﴾ an adjective of يوم; the nominal clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:9-9.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and an adverb of time. ﴿قَوْمُ﴾ its fāʿil (agent). ﴿نُوحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَكَذَّبُوا عَبْدَنا﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَقالُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to كذبوا. ﴿مَجْنُونٌ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَازْدُجِرَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:10-10.t: ﴿فَدَعا رَبَّهُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it is in the position of the accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). ﴿فَانْتَصِرْ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (fāʾ of elucidation), and an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the verbal clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition that does not govern the jussive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿فَفَتَحْنا﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَبْوابَ﴾ its mafʿūl (object). ﴿السَّماءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِماءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مُنْهَمِرٍ﴾ an adjective of ماء; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وَفَجَّرْنَا﴾ a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ its mafʿūl (object). ﴿عُيُوناً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَالْتَقَى﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فجرنا. ﴿الْماءُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿عَلى أَمْرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of verification (taḥqīq). ﴿قُدِرَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause is an adjective of أمر.

daas-irab:13-13.t: ﴿وَحَمَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى ذاتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَلْواحٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَدُسُرٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ألواح.

daas-irab:14-14.t: ﴿تَجْرِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِأَعْيُنِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿جَزاءً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ the two are attached to جزاء. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is latent. ﴿كُفِرَ﴾ a passive past verb; the clause كفر is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the clause كان كفر is the ṣila (relative clause) of man and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:15-15.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ see verse no. 4 of this same sura. ﴿تَرَكْناها﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl (object). ﴿آيَةً﴾ its second mafʿūl; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَهَلْ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and hal is a particle of interrogation. ﴿مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ﴾ genitive in form by the redundant (zāʾida) min, nominative in position as a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-16.t: ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a particle of resumption, and kayfa is an interrogative noun, the advanced khabar (predicate) of kāna. ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿عَذابِي﴾ its noun. ﴿وَنُذُرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to عذابي.

daas-irab:17-17.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in verse 4 of the sura. ﴿يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْآنَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿لِلذِّكْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in verse 15 of the sura.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ عادٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَكَيْفَ كانَ عَذابِي وَنُذُرِ﴾: its i'rab has preceded in verse 16 of the sura.

daas-irab:19-19.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿رِيحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿صَرْصَراً﴾ an adjective of ريحا; the clause أرسلنا.. is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and the clause إنا.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فِي يَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to أرسلنا. ﴿نَحْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُسْتَمِرٍّ﴾ an adjective of نحس.

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is an adjective of ريحا. ﴿كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجازُ﴾ كأن, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿نَخْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُنْقَعِرٍ﴾ an adjective of أعجاز; the clause كأنهم.. is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:21-22.t: Their i'rab has been given before.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِالنُّذُرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:24-24.t: ﴿فَقالُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَبَشَراً﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation, and بشرا is accusative (manṣūb) by way of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ an adjective of بشرا. ﴿واحِداً﴾ an adjective of بشرا. ﴿نَتَّبِعُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّا إِذاً﴾ inna and its noun, and idhan is a particle of answer and requital. ﴿لَفِي﴾ the lām, and the shifted (al-muzaḥlaqa). [Translator's note: so in the source, «اللام والمزحلقة»; meant is "the shifted lām".] ﴿في ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَسُعُرٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ضلال. The clause إنا.. is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿أَأُلْقِيَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of interrogation, and a passive past verb. ﴿الذِّكْرُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ بَيْنِنا﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of conjunction and transition. ﴿هُوَ كَذَّابٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿أَشِرٌ﴾ an adjective; the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:26-26.t: ﴿سَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the sīn is a particle of futurity, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿غَداً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿مَنِ الْكَذَّابُ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَشِرُ﴾ an adjective; the nominal clause stands in place of the two objects of يعلمون.

daas-irab:27-27.t: ﴿إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw, the nūn being dropped for the annexation. ﴿النَّاقَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فتنة. ﴿فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (fāʾ of elucidation), and an imperative verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاصْطَبِرْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ارتقبهم; the nominal clause is also the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:28-28.t: ﴿وَنَبِّئْهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَنَّ الْماءَ قِسْمَةٌ﴾ anna, its noun and its khabar (predicate). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from anna and what follows it stands in place of the second and third objects of نبئ. ﴿كُلُّ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject), annexed to شرب. ﴿شِرْبٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُحْتَضَرٌ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).

daas-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فَنادَوْا صاحِبَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it, and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿فَتَعاطى﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿فَعَقَرَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to تعاطى; the two verbal clauses are conjoined to what precedes them.

daas-irab:30-30.t: Its i'rab has preceded in verse 16 of the sura.

daas-irab:31-31.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿صَيْحَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ an adjective of صيحة; the clause إنا أرسلنا is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَكانُوا﴾ a conjunction, and kāna and its noun. ﴿كَهَشِيمِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar of kāna. ﴿الْمُحْتَظِرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:32-32.t: See verse no. 17 of the sura.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِالنُّذُرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:34-34.t: ﴿إِنَّا أَرْسَلْنا﴾ inna and its noun, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿حاصِباً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿آلَ﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, annexed to لوط. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نَجَّيْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِسَحَرٍ﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause إنا أرسلنا.. is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:35-35.t: ﴿نِعْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نعمة. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). [Translator's note: the source vowels the word as مِنْ; the Quranic word is the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿شَكَرَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of man.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ see verse 4. ﴿أَنْذَرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بَطْشَتَنا﴾ a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَتَمارَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالنُّذُرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿راوَدُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَنْ ضَيْفِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَطَمَسْنا أَعْيُنَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾ a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَذابِي﴾ its mafʿūl. ﴿وَنُذُرِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to عذابي; the clause is the object of an omitted saying.

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿صَبَّحَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿بُكْرَةً﴾ an adverb of time. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿مُسْتَقِرٌّ﴾ an adjective of عذاب; the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:39-40.t: The i'rab of the two verses has preceded.

daas-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿جاءَ آلَ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿النُّذُرُ﴾ fāʿil (agent); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿كَذَّبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كُلِّها﴾ tawkīd (emphasis); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَأَخَذْناهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿أَخْذَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), annexed to عزيز. ﴿عَزِيزٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُقْتَدِرٍ﴾ an adjective of عزيز.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ﴾ the hamza is a particle of disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), and a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ أُولئِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير. ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ an advanced khabar. ﴿بَراءَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي الزُّبُرِ﴾ the two are attached to براءة; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:44-44.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَقُولُونَ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُنْتَصِرٌ﴾ an adjective of جميع.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ﴾ the sīn is for futurity, and a passive imperfect verb and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُوَلُّونَ﴾ a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿الدُّبُرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:46-46.t: ﴿بَلِ﴾ a particle of conjunction and digression (iḍrāb). ﴿السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهى﴾ a mubtadaʾ and its khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَأَمَرُّ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿وَسُعُرٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to ضلال; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:48-48.t: ﴿يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ﴾ an adverb of time, and a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فِي النَّارِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿عَلى وُجُوهِهِمْ﴾ the two are also attached to the verb. ﴿ذُوقُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of an implied (muqaddar) saying. ﴿مَسَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), annexed to سقر. ﴿سَقَرَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:49-49.t: ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, annexed to شيء. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿خَلَقْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿بِقَدَرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause is explicative (tafsīriyya) and has no grammatical position, and the implied verbal clause is the khabar (predicate) of inna.

daas-irab:50-50.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mā is negating. ﴿أَمْرُنا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿واحِدَةٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿كَلَمْحٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿بِالْبَصَرِ﴾ the two are attached to لمح; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿أَهْلَكْنا أَشْياعَكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is the answer to the oath and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَهَلْ مِنْ مُدَّكِرٍ﴾: see verse 16. [Translator's note: so in the source; the i'rab of this phrase was given under verse 15.]

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وَكُلُّ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and a mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَعَلُوهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is an adjective of شيء; and ﴿فِي الزُّبُرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكَبِيرٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to صغير. ﴿مُسْتَطَرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿فِي جَنَّاتٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿وَنَهَرٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it; the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿فِي مَقْعَدِ﴾ a badal (substitute) from His words في جنات. ﴿صِدْقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, annexed to مليك. ﴿مَلِيكٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مُقْتَدِرٍ﴾ an adjective of مليك.
